name: open-scientist
description: ResearchStudio idea_spark as the backbone (retrieval, bottleneck diagnosis, generation, gauntlet, idea card) with research-taste selection layers around it: innovation-lens (15 innovation types) after Phase 0, gap-code-filter (code-grounded unnecessary assumptions + offline oracle admission) after Phase 1, problem-selection (risk table, likelihood x impact, go/no-go; from Anthropic's scientific-problem-selection) after Phase 3, and a three-bottleneck mainline for journal method papers.
